note: Edit freely; scripts/arena-cost.ts reads this file on every run. Keys are model ids as calls.jsonl logs them. 'input' is uncached input. A tier replaces the base rates for a call whose prompt (input + cacheRead + cacheWrite) is above inputTokensAbove. Reasoning tokens are part of output.
